name: Chloe
source: She's a second year student at Ryokufuuin, however she's not your normal, everyday girl. In reality, she's a robot developed by Hitomi Miyazono. Since her model is planned to become a functioning maid-robot, she loves cleaning. Currently, she's working as a maid under Maiki Hoshikawa. Her field training gives a perfect opportunity for her clumsiness to shine through.
